16615-by-still-waters-lyrical-poems-old-.title: By Still Waters Lyrical Poems Old And New
16615-by-still-waters-lyrical-poems-old-.creator: Unknown
16615-by-still-waters-lyrical-poems-old-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Silence and coolness now the earth enfold: Jewels of glittering green, long mists of gold, Hazes of nebulous silver veil the height, And shake in tremors through the shadowy night. Heard through the stillness, as in whispered words, The wandering God-guided wings of birds Ruffle the dark.

58461-reading-how-to-teach-it.title: How To Teach It
58461-reading-how-to-teach-it.creator: Sarah Louise Arnold
58461-reading-how-to-teach-it.description: A book by Sarah Louise Arnold. _Consider what you have in the smallest chosen library. A company of the wisest and wittiest men that could be picked out of all civil countries, in a thousand years, have set in best order the results of their learning and wisdom.

75361-the-basket-maker.title: The Basket Maker
75361-the-basket-maker.creator: Unknown
75361-the-basket-maker.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The ordinary pupil is, and should be, an animated question mark. “Why?” “What for?” and “What makes it do that?” are the ever recurring questions. “Why do you have to have an odd number of spokes with a single weaver?” was the first question asked in the class this year.

arxiv-2212-14334.title: Constant Approximation for Normalized Modularity and Associations Clustering
arxiv-2212-14334.creator: Jakub Łącki, Vahab Mirrokni, Christian Sohler
arxiv-2212-14334.description: Abstract We study the problem of graph clustering under a broad class of objectives in which the quality of a cluster is defined based on the ratio between the number of edges in the cluster, and the total weight of vertices in the cluster.

arxiv-2303-15965.title: SFHarmony: Source Free Domain Adaptation for Distributed Neuroimaging Analysis
arxiv-2303-15965.creator: Nicola K Dinsdale, Mark Jenkinson, Ana IL Namburete 1. Oxford Machine Learning in NeuroImaging (OMNI) Lab, Department of Computer Science, University of Oxford, UK2. Wellcome Centre for Integrative Neuroimaging, FMRIB, University of Oxford, Oxford, UK3. Australian Institute for Machine Learning (AIM
arxiv-2303-15965.description: Abstract To represent the biological variability of clinical neuroimaging populations, it is vital to be able to combine data across scanners and studies. However, different MRI scanners produce images with different characteristics, resulting in a domain shift known as the ‘harmonisation problem’. Additionally, neuroimaging data is inherently personal in nature, leading to data privacy concerns when sharing the data.

arxiv-2304-09552.title: Denoising Cosine Similarity: A Theory-Driven Approach for Efficient Representation Learning
arxiv-2304-09552.creator: Takumi Nakagawa, Yutaro Sanada, Hiroki Waida, Yuhui Zhang, Yuichiro Wada, Kōsaku Takanashi, Tomonori Yamada, Takafumi Kanamori
arxiv-2304-09552.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Takumi Nakagawa, Yutaro Sanada, Hiroki Waida, Yuhui Zhang, Yuichiro Wada, Kōsaku Takanashi, Tomonori Yamada, Takafumi Kanamori. Representation learning has been increasing its impact on the research and practice of machine learning, since it enables to learn representations that can apply to various downstream tasks efficiently. However, recent works pay little attention to the fact that real-world datasets used during the stage of representation learning are commonly contaminated by noise, which can degrade the quality of learned representations.

arxiv-2308-02140.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning Empowered Rate Selection of XP-HARQ
arxiv-2308-02140.creator: Da Wu, Jiahui Feng, Zheng Shi, Hongjiang Lei, Guanghua Yang, and Shaodan Ma
arxiv-2308-02140.description: Abstract The complex transmission mechanism of cross-packet hybrid automatic repeat request (XP-HARQ) hinders its optimal system design. To overcome this difficulty, this letter attempts to use the deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to solve the rate selection problem of XP-HARQ over correlated fading channels.

arxiv-2405-14974.title: LOVA 3 : Learning to Visual Question Answering, Asking and Assessment
arxiv-2405-14974.creator: Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Pan Zhou, Difei Gao, Zechen Bai, Mike Zheng Shou
arxiv-2405-14974.description: Abstract Question answering, asking, and assessment are three innate human traits crucial for understanding the world and acquiring knowledge. By enhancing these capabilities, humans can more effectively utilize data, leading to better comprehension and learning outcomes. Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) primarily focus on question answering, often neglecting the full potential of questioning and assessment skills.

arxiv-2411-00190.title: Monitoring fairness in machine learning models that predict patient mortality in the ICU DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.2411.00190 Conference: KDD ’21: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, Workshop on Measures and Best Practices for Responsible AI; August 14–18, 2021; Singapore KDD ’21
arxiv-2411-00190.creator: Tempest A. van Schaik, Xinggang Liu, Louis Atallah, Omar Badawi
arxiv-2411-00190.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tempest A. van Schaik, Xinggang Liu, Louis Atallah, Omar Badawi. This work proposes a fairness monitoring approach for machine learning models that predict patient mortality in the ICU. We investigate how well models perform for patient groups with different race, sex and medical diagnoses. We investigate Documentation bias in clinical measurement, showing how fairness analysis provides a more detailed and insightful comparison of model performance than traditional accuracy metrics alone.

arxiv-2502-20023.title: Temperature profiles of accretion disks in luminous active galactic nuclei derived from ultraviolet spectroscopic variability
arxiv-2502-20023.creator: Suyeon Son, Minjin Kim, Luis C. Ho
arxiv-2502-20023.description: Abstract The characteristic timescale ( τ \tau ) of the continuum variability of the accretion disk in active galactic nuclei (AGNs) is known to be related to the thermal timescale, which is predicted to scale with AGN luminosity ( L L ) and the rest-frame wavelength ( λ RF \lambda_{\rm RF} ) as t th ∝ L 0.

arxiv-2601-16462.title: Graph-Anchored Knowledge Indexing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2601-16462.creator: Zhenghao Liu, Mingyan Wu, Xinze Li, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Cheng Yang, Minghe Yu, Zheni Zeng, Maosong Sun
arxiv-2601-16462.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for mitigating hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge. Nevertheless, effectively integrating and interpreting key evidence scattered across noisy documents remains a critical challenge for existing RAG systems.

arxiv-2604-16702.title: Autonomous Vehicle Collision Avoidance With Racing Parameterized Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2604-16702.creator: Shathushan Sivashangaran, Vihaan Dutta, Apoorva Khairnar, Sepideh Gohari, Azim Eskandarian

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alexis-paulin.creator: Louis Delamarre
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alexis-paulin.description: Article 'Alexis-Paulin Paris' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-11111264.title: Effective and Economical Option of Anesthesia in Retrograde Intrarenal Surgery
pmc-11111264.creator: Turkan Sadi, Ozan Ekmekcioglu, Ebru Efe Ekmekcioglu, Hakan Ayvaz, Lokman Irkilata, Akkan Avci
pmc-11111264.description: BackgroundThere is only limited data in the literature showing the effect of anesthesia methods on the success of retrograd intrarenal surgery. The aim of this study was to compare and evaluate retrograd intrarenal surgery cases performed under spinal and general anesthesia in terms of effectiveness, cost, hospitalization time and complications.

pmc-11461875.title: Deprivation of loading during rat Achilles tendon healing affects extracellular matrix composition and structure, and reduces cell density and alignment
pmc-11461875.creator: Malin Hammerman, Maria Pierantoni, Hanna Isaksson, Pernilla Eliasson
pmc-11461875.description: Tendon healing involves mechanosensitive cells that adapt to mechanical stimuli through mechanotransduction, resulting in increased tissue strength. However, detailed insights into this process in response to different loads remain limited. We aimed to investigate how different loading regimes impact the spatial composition of elastin and collagens during Achilles tendon healing.

pmc-11568167.title: Anti-VEGF treatment outcome prediction based on optical coherence tomography images in neovascular age-related macular degeneration using a deep neural network
pmc-11568167.creator: Jeong Mo Han, Jinyoung Han, Junseo Ko, Juho Jung, Ji In Park, Joon Seo Hwang, Jeewoo Yoon, Jae Ho Jung, Daniel Duck-Jin Hwang
pmc-11568167.description: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a major cause of blindness in developed countries, and the number of affected patients is increasing worldwide. Intravitreal injections of anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) are the standard therapy for neovascular AMD (nAMD), and optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a crucial tool for evaluating the anatomical condition of the macula.

pmc-11619430.title: Academic performance, perceptions, and motivations of medical PhD students in Ukraine during wartime: a mixed methods study
pmc-11619430.creator: Iurii Kuchyn, Kateryna Bielka, Lesya Lymar, Livia Puljak
pmc-11619430.description: BackgroundThe full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine, initiated on February 22, 2022, has created numerous challenges, including the need to study under the constant threat of bombardment. This study aimed to analyze the effects of the war on the academic performance of medical PhD students in Ukraine, explore their perceptions of stressful wartime events, and identify their motivations and future aspirations.

pmc-11633306.title: Identification of a Missense Mutation in the FLNC Gene from a Chinese Family with Restrictive Cardiomyopathy [Letter]
pmc-11633306.creator: Hasta Handayani Idrus
pmc-11633306.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). that cause genetic diseases, one of which is Restrictive Cardiomyopathy (RCM). Cardiomyopathy is a heterogeneous myocardial disease associated with electrical dysfunction in the heart muscle, resulting in hypertrophy or dilation of the ventricles of the heart.2 Pathogenic mutations in the FLNC gene can be an early genetic screening in patients or families of patients with suspected restrictive cardiomyopathy; this is important for assessing the risk of carrier patients and aims to intervene early so that it does not become a more severe

pmc-12508081.title: Targeting TGF-β–Smad2/3–JNK1-mediated SIRT1 activity overcomes the chemoresistance of KRAS mutation lung cancer
pmc-12508081.creator: Dong Hoon Shin, Minyoung Choi, Chungyong Han, Sang Soo Kim
pmc-12508081.description: Patients with lung cancer harboring a KRAS oncogenic driver mutation have a very poor prognosis. Recently, we reported that SIRT1 is upregulated by the KRASMut–c-Myc axis, and that KRASMut-induced SIRT1 is stably deacetylated at lysine 104, which in turn increases KRASMut activity and enhances chemoresistance.

pmc-13099926.title: Integrating core muscle morphology into a predictive model for residual back pain after vertebral augmentation
pmc-13099926.creator: Mingyang Huang, Genzhong Xu, Ming Luo
pmc-13099926.description: BackgroundResidual back pain (RBP) after percutaneous vertebral augmentation (PVA) for osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures (OVCF) remains a significant clinical challenge. Traditional prediction models focus primarily on bone mineral density and procedural factors. This study aimed to develop and validate a novel nomogram that incorporates the morphology of core muscles, notably the gluteal muscles, for personalized RBP risk stratification.

pmc-13201161.title: Platonic representation of foundation machine learning interatomic potentials
pmc-13201161.creator: Zhenzhu Li, Aron Walsh
pmc-13201161.description: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have emerged as powerful tools for atomistic simulation, yet different models encode chemical environments in incompatible latent spaces, limiting direct comparison and interoperability. The platonic representation hypothesis suggests that sufficiently capable models converge towards a shared statistical representation of reality.

pmc-13212811.title: Estimating Baseline Survival Function in the Proportional Hazards Model Under Monotone Hazards
pmc-13212811.creator: Yunhong Wu, Rick Chappell
pmc-13212811.description: In biomedical studies where patient risk is known to increase over time, estimating the baseline survival function under the Cox proportional hazards (PH) model becomes particularly challenging when data involve delayed entry (left truncation) and incomplete follow-up (right censoring). This paper proposes a Breslow-type estimator for left-truncated and right-censored data under a monotone hazard assumption.

pmc-13249187.title: Biomedical engineer density per hospital bed: A medical device quality indicator for Mexican Healthcare System
pmc-13249187.creator: Luis G. Ayala, Nadezhda Aguilar Blas, Norma Patricia Navor Galeana
pmc-13249187.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe measurement of health indicators that enable the estimation of a system’s capacity to provide adequate patient care constitutes a highly relevant factor in the evaluation of healthcare systems. Traditionally, these indicators include variables such as physician density, nursing staff, and other human resources; however, a critical component that often receives less attention is the capacity of healthcare institutions to sustain high-quality infrastructure and medical technology, which are essential to ensuring the continuity, safety, and efficiency of healthcare services.

pmc-13265224.title: Prognostic significance and pathological correlation analysis of DKK4 in colorectal cancer
pmc-13265224.creator: Xiaoxiong Wang, Minghai Shan, Xia Qiao, Lu Ding, Jiali Yang, Fang He, Yushen Mian, Xu Zhang, Shaoqi Yang
pmc-13265224.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) is a highly prevalent and lethal digestive system malignancy worldwide, which mostly develops through a multi-step progression from normal mucosa to adenoma and finally invasive carcinoma. Lack of specific biomarkers for precancerous lesions limits early screening and intervention efficacy.

pmc-13314195.title: Development of a multiplex polymerase chain reaction assay for the detection of Piroplasma (Babesia spp. and Theileria spp.), Anaplasma spp., and Trypanosoma evansi in cattle
pmc-13314195.creator: Jiravich Methawiroon, Piangjai Chalermwong, Ornarin Boonjint, Piangdow Chiawvitkan, Sakulchit Wichianchot, Chanapath Thabthimsri, Preeyanuch Thongpoo, Ketsarin Kamyingkird, Sathaporn Jittapalapong, Eukote Suwan
pmc-13314195.description: Background:Blood parasites cause serious drawbacks in the livestock industry. The detection methods rely on microscopic examination and polymerase chain reaction (PCR), which requires an expert person, labor, time, and cost.Aim:In this study, a multiplex PCR has been developed for hemoparasites consisting of Piroplasma (Babesia spp. and Theileria spp.), Anaplasma spp., and Trypanosoma evansi detections.

pmc-13396759.title: Non-contact on-device detection of obstructive sleep apnea from infrared video
pmc-13396759.creator: You Rim Choi, Dongik Park, Hyun Kyung Lee, Suahn Bae, Sehyun Park, Dong-Kyu Kim, Yong Min Kim, Chan-Soon Park, Hyung-Sin Kim, Hyun-Woo Shin
pmc-13396759.description: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) affects nearly one billion people worldwide, yet most cases remain undiagnosed because standard testing requires overnight polysomnography, which is costly and inconvenient. Here we show that SlAction, a contact-free, wall-mounted near-infrared (NIR) video system, can estimate the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) and detect positional OSA entirely on-device, without attached physiological sensors or cloud-based data transfer.
